data.exact_reserve_text: An adverse run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.4m (2014: run-off deviation of GBP nil) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve movements on 2012 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse run-off deviation experienced during the year related to reserve movements on the 2012 WAQS contract with Syndicate 2003

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2088 reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 75.697m at 1 Jan 2015 and experienced a small adverse prior-year run-off (strengthening) of GBP 0.4m during 2015, wholly attributable to reserve movements on the 2012 year of account under a Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003. The movement represents approximately 0.53% of opening gross claims outstanding and appears influenced by adverse claims development related to reinsurance arrangements.
raw_causal_phrases: An adverse run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.4m (2014: run-off deviation of GBP nil) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
This is offset by the challenging rating environment and lower volume of reserve releases on back years in Syndicate 2003 when compared with 2014.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and segmental premium amounts are taken from the technical provisions reconciliation and segmental analysis (explicit, gross, in GBP 000s). The prior year development figure (GBP 0.4m) is taken from Note 9 wording which uses the phrase 'adverse run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.4m' - the note states the amount explicitly but is ambiguous whether presented gross or net of reinsurance; it is therefore treated as the quantified prior year movement (strengthening) but confidence is reduced and this caveat is noted. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 30) which could be used as a cross-check.
